restore.warning: This restores every writable data block and sector trailer, verifying each block. UID is not changed by default.
restore.uid_help: The dump's 4-byte UID is used by default and can be changed; keys and card capability are checked next.
uid.warning: Only for CUID/Gen2 cards that can change block 0 using an ordinary write command. NFCX retains manufacturer data, calculates BCC, and backs up block 0 before writing.
recovery.warning: NFCX first scans prior and common keys. Without a seed key, it uses Darkside as needed, then Nested. If sectors remain unresolved, it uses Hardnested, then verifies reads sector by sector. Darkside can run for up to one hour and Hardnested for up to six hours. Keep the card and reader in place. Use only on cards you own or are authorized to test.
